subject.title: feat(workspace): add tiered bootstrap loading with configurable bootstrapTier

question: Should OpenClaw accept `agents.defaults.bootstrapTier` as the public prompt-context control for workspace bootstrap files, including the `minimal`/`standard`/`full` split for hook-loaded extras?
rationale: The implementation is coherent and proven, but the choice creates a user-facing config contract that overlaps existing `contextInjection`, `lightContext`, bootstrap budgets, and broader context-control proposals.

options.title: Accept bootstrapTier after refresh
options.body: Approve this API shape, then require a current-main rebase plus aligned docs/tests before merge.

options.title: Rework under existing controls
options.body: Ask for a narrower replacement that uses or extends current `contextInjection`, `lightContext`, or bootstrap budget controls instead of adding this new option.

options.title: Close as not planned
options.body: Close the PR and linked proposal if maintainers decide tiered bootstrap policy should not be a core config surface.

recommendation.title: Accept bootstrapTier after refresh
recommendation.body: Approve this API shape, then require a current-main rebase plus aligned docs/tests before merge.
